light_description: Extreme fuzz and overload pedal with gain and overload controls that can move from thick saturated fuzz into collapsing, gated and octave-heavy breakdown.
High-gain fuzz/distortion designed for dense, aggressive saturation and extreme wall-of-sound textures.
Heavy bass fuzz designed to retain substantial low-end while producing thick, saturated distortion and fuzz.
Dual-band analog fuzz and filter that processes low and high frequencies separately for tightly sculpted or chaotic fuzz textures.
Two-mode fuzz ranging from a more controllable driving fuzz that cleans up with guitar volume to a louder, harsher saturated fuzz.
Dense high-gain fuzz built around a huge saturated wall of sound, with a broad tonal range from thick low-heavy fuzz to cutting distortion.
All-analog overdrive ranging from a light boost to harmonically rich saturated drive, intended to push and color an amplifier rather than act as a transparent booster.
Analog octave-up effect combining clang-like harmonics with fuzz, octave textures and aggressive gain that can become abrasive and drone-like.
Highly interactive fuzz built around extreme bias and filtering, capable of fuzz, distortion, buzz, synth-like and unstable broken-signal textures.
High-gain fuzz with an aggressive, saturated character designed for large, abrasive and sustaining fuzz textures.
Stereo treble boost and distortion combining focused upper-frequency boost with saturated drive for added presence and attack.
Multi-voice distortion and fuzz platform offering eight internally selectable sounds from overdrive and distortion to extreme fuzz.
Power-amp-style distortion built for enormous, saturated output with a simple control scheme and a strong low-to-high gain response.
Fuzz pedal with a dark, saturated voice and a flexible gain range suited to thick modern fuzz tones.
Dynamic fuzzdriver-style dirt pedal covering responsive overdrive through compressed, saturated fuzz with strong amplifier interaction.
Fuzz pedal centered on a direct, aggressive fuzz voice with strong saturation and a straightforward control set.
Low-signal bass overdrive voiced around mid-focused clipping while preserving low-end response and attack.
Low-end-focused fuzzdriver that combines overdrive-style punch with thick saturated fuzz for bass-rich guitar and bass tones.
Flexible overdrive designed for amp-like breakup with adjustable gain and tonal shaping from cleaner push to thicker drive.
Four-stage muff-family fuzz with a tighter low end and more aggressive, articulate voicing than a traditional muff-style fuzz.
Germanium overdrive with a dynamic response and amp-like breakup, moving from low-gain warmth toward thicker saturated drive.
Versatile dirt pedal with a broad gain range from gritty overdrive-like textures to saturated fuzz and distortion.
Compact multi-mode overdrive with a mid-focused drive character and added tone-shaping options for boost through heavier overdrive.
High-output fuzz focused on strong attack, sustain and a direct, saturated fuzz sound with minimal controls.
Vintage-voiced fuzz built around a thick, harmonically rich response that can move from articulate fuzz into saturated sustain.
Heavy sustaining fuzz with a thick low end and powerful, harmonically dense character designed for large saturated textures.
Germanium/silicon hybrid muff-style fuzz ranging from warm gritty overdrive-like tones to huge sustaining fuzz, with a tighter response than many traditional muffs.
Dynamic overdrive designed around amplifier-style breakup, providing responsive low-to-medium gain with a strong touch-sensitive character.
Multi-mode overdrive offering a wide range of gain, clipping and mid-voicing combinations for low-gain drive through thicker stacked sounds.
Compact mid-focused overdrive with multiple clipping modes ranging from clean boost-like push to asymmetric and higher-gain drive.
Simple discrete overdrive designed to add gritty amplifier-style breakup while responding strongly to picking dynamics and guitar volume.
Silicon/germanium-style dynamic distortion offering responsive low-to-medium gain tones with a broad, amp-like range.
Compact fuzz with a thick, saturated voice suited to sustained and aggressive fuzz textures.
Flexible active-EQ overdrive and distortion providing tight low end, strong mids and a broad range from focused drive to heavier gain.
High-gain destructive fuzz device built for dense saturation, compressed sustain and aggressive texture.
Three-transistor fuzz with a raw, harmonically rich character that moves from sputtery low-gain textures to thicker distortion-like fuzz.
Straightforward fuzz delivering a thick, sustaining sound with strong low-end body and a pronounced saturated character.
Light-to-medium gain translucent overdrive with active low and high EQ capable of moving from near-clean boost to articulate lead drive.
Dynamic vintage-inspired overdrive with adjustable weight and saturation, covering responsive breakup without a conventional tone control.
Dynamic distortion with active tone shaping and a broad gain range from crunchy drive to dense saturated distortion.
Germanium fuzz designed for thick, harmonically rich response with strong cleanup from the guitar volume and additional bias and contour control.
Silicon-based fuzz aimed at a tighter, more aggressive fuzz character with added tone and control flexibility.
Highly flexible gain pedal capable of clean boost, non-compressed overdrive, distortion and fuzz with EQ shaping and strong cleanup from guitar volume.
Standalone distortion pedal offering saturated gain with broad tonal shaping for heavier rock-oriented sounds.
Overdrive with independent boost and multiple voicings, covering clean push, classic mid-focused drive and higher-gain tones.
Dual-function drive pedal combining a discrete booster with a dedicated distortion circuit for stacked and high-gain applications.
Heavy distortion and fuzz pedal intended for thick, aggressive saturation with a broad, high-gain response.
Dynamic overdrive designed around amplifier-like response, moving from lower-gain breakup into strong saturated drive with a low/high-pass voicing switch.
Fuzz pedal with a selectable octave-up effect, covering conventional saturated fuzz and focused upper-octave sounds.
Two-stage overdrive/distortion offering a smoother low-gain side and a more saturated second clipping stage for heavier drive.
Artist-oriented overdrive designed for warm, singing amplifier breakup with a broad gain range and strong sustain.
Vintage-style fuzz designed around a thick, harmonically rich character with strong sustain and classic British fuzz response.
Fat distortion/fuzz with an active tone control and separate octave-up footswitch, covering thick fuzz and searing upper-octave sounds.
Three-voice overdrive combining multiple drive flavors in one enclosure for stacking, tonal blending and amp-pushing applications.
Compact Way Huge fuzz delivering thick, sustaining saturation with a straightforward high-gain character.
Dynamic overdrive built around a strong mid-focused voice with additional tonal shaping for low-mid and high-frequency adjustment.
Fuzz with octave-up character, designed for aggressive upper-harmonic textures and thick saturated sounds.
Octave-inflected overdrive combining a driven core with upper-octave coloration for more harmonically complex lead textures.
Simple, highly responsive overdrive with a distinctive gain character that moves from warm drive into thick saturated tones.
High-gain jumbo fuzz with heavy low end, broad sustain and extensive tone-shaping controls for scooped through fuller midrange sounds.
Dual-function bass pedal combining soft-clipping overdrive with thick Russian-style fuzz and a separate clean preamp path for low-end clarity.
